title: Almost Periodic Characters and Hamel Coefficients in TVG Topologies on the Real Line
summary: We study topological vector group topologies on the real line generated by Hamel coefficient functions and circle-valued characters. We determine their continuous characters, completions, and isomorphisms, and construct a sequence separating modular convergence from convergence of real-valued observations. We also classify precompact topologies and prove that no greatest nondiscrete topology exists.
